# Chess piece font

`noto-sans-symbols-2-chess.woff2` is a subset of
[Noto Sans Symbols 2](https://github.com/notofonts/symbols) holding only the six
filled chess glyphs the app draws (U+265A to U+265F). It was made with the
Google Fonts API (`family=Noto+Sans+Symbols+2&text=♚♛♜♝♞♟`).

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, full text in `OFL.txt` in this folder.
